findings.message: The taskIoFail comment says the E903 port-failure shape "lives once here", but writeTask (line 109) and taskCheckpoint (line 232) in the same file still spell out fail("CDX-E903", saved.error.message, saved.error.remediation, ...) by hand; either route them through taskIoFail or narrow the comment to taskClose so it does not overclaim.
